subject.text: A named profile selects over the extensions this router holds and the upstreams it serves, and its projection says what each harness would have to hold without changing any of them. A symlink in a harness skills directory whose target has gone is reported as dangling and projected as a repair naming that target, never as an absent entry; a harness with no skills directory at all is named rather than omitted, and a directory that could not be opened is carried apart from an empty one. Every projected step states its reach: durable where the bytes would land and nothing makes a live session re-read them, tell-elsewhere where the protocol's own announcement exists in the TypeScript router and not in this one, and refused where the step would need another program's MCP configuration rewritten. Nothing applies a projection.
